propositions: Event bodies containing credentials (API keys, tokens, PATs) are accepted by the write path without screening and land on disk
A single credential posted in a comment caused all 153 concurrent store writes to queue local-only when GitHub push protection rejected the shared tickets branch

The write boundary is finalize_event (called by append_event, reconciler inbound_translate, and txn/delete cores), not append_event alone, because reconciler deliberately bypasses append_event to avoid eager commit+push
Refused writes must name the matched secret family and field+line location without echoing the secret value, and must be recoverable via --allow-secret-pattern=<reason> with audit trail

Detection patterns tuned by live-store measurement must use fixed-width windows (not greedy quantifiers) and line-anchoring to avoid false negatives from padding and false positives from prose descriptions
